method.scope: Selected managed kernels only; no native comparison or full performance parity verdict
method.variants: Forced pairs change one kernel Original/Optimized and hold the other Automatic; optional automatic-policy pair compares both Original against both Automatic; exact preferences retained per comparison
method.order: Six quartets by default; require an even count, balanced ABBA/BAAB by comparison and block index; A=baseline, B=candidate
method.warmup: Each leg receives the same untimed warmups; options are immutable and prepared outside the timer
method.iterations: Fixed requested count, except inputs below1024 pixels use max(requested,100); actual iterations retained per comparison
method.calibration: None; both variants use identical recorded iteration counts
method.latency: Only complete public byte-array Encode calls timed; output equality checked after stopping each timer
method.ratio: Each quartet uses geometric mean candidate / geometric mean baseline; primary statistic is median of those paired ratios
method.gc: Natural GC included; no forced collections or no-GC region; per-leg allocations and collection counts retained
method.evidencePreference: Baseline or candidate variant name only when valid and every quartet ratio lies beyond1+/-0.005 in the same direction; otherwise inconclusive
method.rawMeasurements: raw-comparisons/*.json is updated after each completed quartet, before analysis; nonfinite raw values use named JSON strings
